resources.string: Waiting for an accessible screen. Back opens reader controls.
Speech is unavailable. Keep TalkBack enabled and open reader settings to retry.
The reader cannot connect to the game. Open settings or return to the phone.
Unavailable. No game action was performed.
This screen needs a dedicated accessibility adapter.
The screen changed. Select the item again.
The reader could not load this screen. Reader settings remain available.

With the internal reader and touch exploration off: swipe left or up for the previous item, right or down for the next item. Left handed mode reverses horizontal menu browsing only. Swipe distance and maximum duration can be changed in reader setup and restored to defaults. Double tap to select the item. Hold to hear details. Tap with two fingers to stop speech. Reader controls include a safe eight-direction practice that sends no game actions. Fast movement is off by default; complete the practice or explicitly skip it before enabling. In the world, each fast movement swipe may spend a game turn. Turn it off to browse the world list. Back opens reader controls. With TalkBack, use its usual gestures and the labeled buttons.
Fast movement is off. Activate to practice all eight directions safely; practice swipes do not move the character.
Fast movement is off. Activate to turn it on; with touch exploration off, world swipes send registered movement actions and may spend game turns.
Fast movement is on. With touch exploration off, an eight-direction world swipe sends one movement action and may spend a game turn. Activate this control to turn it off and resume list browsing.
Skip practice and enable fast movement. With touch exploration off, world swipes can move the character and spend game turns.
Safe swipe practice uses internal reader gestures. TalkBack touch exploration keeps its usual swipes. Choose the clearly labeled skip option only if you want to enable movement without this practice.

Safe movement practice. Swipe in each of the eight directions. The reader will name the direction and count your progress. Practice swipes send no game action and spend no turn. Double tap or press Back to exit.
%1$s. %2$d of 8 directions practiced. No game action was sent.
All eight directions practiced. No game action was sent. Fast movement remains off; activate its control if you choose to enable it.
Practice ended. Your movement setting was not changed.
Open the world screen before starting movement practice.
That movement direction is unavailable. No game action was performed.
I heard the sample. Enable the experimental internal reader.

Built-in spoken navigation is active. Swipe left or right to move through the controls, double tap to activate the focused control, swipe up or down to adjust a focused rate or gesture setting, and tap with two fingers to stop speech. The Vietnamese sample must finish before you can enable the internal reader.
Gesture settings. Left handed mode reverses menu browsing only. World swipes always keep their named direction.
The game data could not be installed. Check available storage and try again.
Game data was not installed. Check free storage and device access, then retry. Technical details: %1$s
Use the labeled buttons on this screen to continue or exit safely.
Internal reader enabled. This development version does not yet support every game screen. Keep TalkBack available for recovery.
Internal reader disabled. Existing game controls remain selected.
